blocks.p: The *Building* tab of the *World* window lists the structures you can build. It is laid out as the *Crafting* tab is (Chapter 27): the list at the left, and at the right the structure you click.

Pick a category from the pop-up at the top left, or search the structures by name in the box beside it. *Sort* and *Show* at the foot of the tab order and filter the list. With *Show: Ready* on, the list holds only what you can build now.

The open structure gives its name, *Known* when you have learned the recipe, how long it takes, and the *Required* list of everything it needs, with a count for each. A red square marks what is missing.

list: Pick a category, or search the structures by name.
Click the structure in the list.
Set how many with *-* and *+* beside *Build*.
When no red square shows in the *Required* list, click *Build*.

blocks.note: *Build* stays dimmed while a red square shows in the *Required* list.
